lines.speaker: quarter_regular
lines.text: Your friend has been staring at the founder's portrait over the bar for ten minutes. Everyone stares at it. Nobody stares like that.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: It is a good likeness. They have made the jaw heavier, which they always do.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: The man at the end of the bar has looked at me four times and is now reaching for a handset. I would like to be on the other side of this conversation for once.

choices.text: We leave. You are not a curiosity.
